## What changed

Describe the objective, implementation, and user-visible result.

## Evidence

- [ ] Tests cover the acceptance criteria and important failure modes.
- [ ] Lint, type checks, tests, and builds pass locally or in CI.
- [ ] Configuration, migration, and rollback effects are documented.
- [ ] Logs and attached artifacts contain no secrets or sensitive sensor data.

## Safety and audit review

- [ ] This change does not add a capability or change an approval boundary.
- [ ] Or: capability/policy changes include a threat-model update and decision record.
- [ ] Robot-facing behavior was tested in simulation, including stop/failure behavior.
- [ ] Material decisions and generated/tool provenance can be recorded in the audit trail.
